title: Zesty Quick Chinese Turkish Delight Buddha Jumps Over Wall
description: A quick-fix Chinese dish featuring Turkish Delight, made with herbal and shaggy ingredients, cooked in a papillote and served in a Buddha Jumps Over Wall form, this macrobiotic-friendly meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, grated ginger, and minced garlic
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms and chopped bok choy to the bowl and toss to coat
Cut the Turkish Delight into small cubes and add to the bowl, tossing gently to combine
Lay a sheet of parchment paper on a flat surface and brush with a small amount of sesame oil
Spoon one quarter of the mixture onto the center of the parchment paper
Fold the parchment paper over the mixture to form a triangle, and press the edges together to seal
Repeat with the remaining ingredients and parchment paper
Place the packets on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes
Serve the Buddha Jumps Over Wall hot, garnished with additional grated ginger if desired
